scripts.features:
This GUI is a user interface in Roblox that provides various interactive features for players. Below is an overview of each button's function:

1. Draggable Frame:

Allows the user to drag the GUI around the screen. This feature lets players move the interface to any position they prefer on the game screen.



2. Buttons: Each button performs a different interaction or effect when clicked. These buttons are used to provide different experiences for the players.

Bomb Button: When clicked, the player receives a "bomb" tool. The bomb creates an explosion effect and detonates after 3 seconds.

Skybox Loop Button: The game's skybox (the background sky) continuously changes. A set of images is displayed in sequence, and this loop repeats indefinitely.

Random Explosion Button: This button creates explosions at random locations. The explosions have a blast radius, affecting nearby areas and players.

Turkish Sultan Button: This button "freezes" all players and causes a block to spin above their heads. If a player is standing under the block, they "die" (their character is destroyed).

Block Spawner Button: This button spawns "blocks" at random locations. If a player touches one of these blocks, they "die" (their character is destroyed).

Message Button: Clicking this button displays a message on the screen. The message is a customized text that includes a player-specific line, for example, "XXXOMER12345678: Your brother is here, get out of here."



3. Visual and Sound Effects: Some buttons include specific visual and sound effects. For instance, the "Bomb" button triggers an explosion sound and effect. The "Skybox Loop" button changes the skybox images continuously.


4. Mobile Support: This GUI is optimized to work on mobile devices as well. The drag-and-drop functionality is designed to work smoothly on touchscreens, making it mobile-friendly.


5. User Experience: The GUI is structured in a way that allows players to interact with various game effects through simple buttons. The design focuses on both functionality and ease of use.
